sources.title: LingBot VLA v2 6B: An Open, Ascend-Ready Vision-Language-Action Model ...
sources.snippet: LingBot VLA v2 6B, newly hosted on Modelers.cn, offers a different path. It's an open-source, 6B-parameter model that takes image input and language instructions directly to executable robot actions — and it's designed with the Huawei/Ascend ecosystem in mind. What makes LingBot VLA v2 worth a look is its focus on practicality.
